findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri kichwa kuwa Kiswahili, ikizingatia mantiki na mtindo wa asili. Pendekezo: “Mnafaa Kuzaliwa Upya” au “Lazima Uzaliwe Tena.” Chagua moja inayofaa kwa muktadha wa jarida na tumia ile ile katika eneo la tafsiri.
Tafsiri sehemu/section kwenda Kiswahili kwa mtiririko wa tovuti. Pendekezo: “Fikra za Misionari” au “Mawazo ya Misionari.” Tumia maneno hayo badala ya Kiingereza.

findings.source_quote: Overall, the American church seems to be thriving financially. Our businesses are improving, along with our standard of living, while spiritually, many Christians seem to be losing their zeal for godliness.
findings.suggested_fix: Rekebisha kifungu ili kurudisha maana ya asili. Badilisho sasa limeleta neno lisilo sahihi (“Kinga moja”) na kumfanya msamiati kueleweka kwa uwiano usiokuwa wa asili. Pendekezo: “Kwa ujumla, kanisa la Marekani linaonekana kufanikiwa kifedha. Biashara zetu zinaimarika pamoja na kiwango chetu cha maisha, lakini kiroho, Wakristo wengi wanaonekana kupoteza shauku yao ya kumtii Mungu.”
findings.translation_quote: Kinga moja, kanisa la Marekani linaonekana kufanikiwa kifedha. Biashara zetu zinaimarika, pamoja na kiwango chetu cha maisha, ilhali kiroho, Wakristo wengi wanaonekana kupoteza msukumo wa kuwa watiifu kwa Mungu.

findings.source_quote: Here you have a man that may be satisfied with his life. He has possessions and good health.
findings.suggested_fix: Rekebisha tafsiri iliyoambatana ili iwe imara kwa maana. Tafsiri ya sasa (“ametoroka na maisha yake”) ni isiyo sahihi na inabadili ujumbe. Pendekezo: “Hapa kuna mtu ambaye huenda alikuwa ameteremka/ameshiba katika maisha yake. Ana mali na afya njema.” (Badilisha “ametoroka” kwa “ameteremka/ameshiba” au maneno sawa ya Kiswahili.)
findings.translation_quote: Hapa una mtu ambaye huenda alikuwa ametoroka na maisha yake. Ana mali na afya njema.

findings.source_quote: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved… –Romans 10:9-10.
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri mstari wa Warumi kwa uaminifu wa kiroho wa asili. Tafsiri iliyotumika (“utahifadhiwa…”) sio uwakilishi sahihi wa “thou shalt be saved.” Pendekezo: “Kwa maana ikiwa utakiri kwa mdomo wako Bwana Yesu, na ukimwamini moyoni mwako kwamba Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, utakuwa umeokolewa… –Warumi 10:9-10.” Hifadhi neno “umeokolewa/utaokolewa” ili kuendana na maana ya Kiingereza.
findings.translation_quote: Kwa maana ikiwa usipokuwa ukikiri kwa mdomo wako Bwana Yesu, na ukimwamini moyoni mwako kwamba Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu, utahifadhiwa… –Warumi 10:9-10.

findings.source_quote: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field –Matthew 13:44.
findings.suggested_fix: Rekebisha lafudhi ndogo na mtiririko wa maneno. Tafsiri inayo sasa ina maneno yasiyo sehemu (mfano: “mifano ya shamba lenye hazina” badala ya “mchoro/ mfano”). Pendekezo: “Yesu anasimulia mfano wa shamba lenye hazina iliyofichwa—‘Tena ufalme wa mbinguni ni kama hazina iliyofichwa ndani ya shamba; mtu akipata, anamficha; naye kwa furaha yake aende na auze kila alicho nacho, naye anonunua shamba huo’ –Mathayo 13:44.”
findings.translation_quote: Yesu anasimulia mifano ya shamba lenye hazina zilizopotea au zilizofichwa—Tena ufalme wa mbinguni ni kama hazina iliyofichwa ndani ya shamba; mtu akipata, anamficha; naye kwa furaha yake aende na auze kila alicho nacho, naye anonunua shamba huo –Mathayo 13:44.

findings.source_quote: …Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God –John 3:3.
findings.suggested_fix: Kiswahili kinachotumika kinapaswa kuwahisha maneno yaliyo kwenye asili bila kubadilisha uzito wa mafundisho. Tafsiri iliyopo ni karibu lakini inatumia 'Ndiyo, ndiyo' kama kurudia 'Verily, verily' – ni sawa tuzo, lakini sehemu nyingine za kifungu zimepunguzwa au zimerudishwa kwa mtindo usio sawa. Pendekezo: “…Kweli, kwelikweli, nawaambia, isipokuwa mtu azaliwa tena, hawezi kuona ufalme wa Mungu –Yohana 3:3.” Hakikisha mtiririko unaendana na vifungu vilivyotumika awali.
findings.translation_quote: …Ndiyo, ndiyo, nawaambia, isipokuwa mtu azaliwa tena, hawezi kuona ufalme wa Mungu –Yohana 3:3.

findings.source_quote: …the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it –Hebrews 4:2.  But without faith it is impossible to please him… –Hebrews 11:6.  And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts –Galatians 5:24.
findings.suggested_fix: Kila aya ya Maandiko iliyoorodheshwa inapaswa kuwasilishwa kwa Kiswahili kinachoakisi maana ya Kiingereza kama ilivyo kwenye chanzo. Baadhi ya tafsiri za vifungu vimepunguzwa au kupangwa kwa mtindo tofauti; hakikisha kila nukuu inarudisha maana rasmi na mtiririko sawa. Pendekezo: rendez-vous kila nukuu kwa tafsiri: “…neno lilohubiriwa halikuwa nao faida kwao, kwa kuwa halikutanganywa na imani kwa wale waliolisikia –Waebrania 4:2.” “Bila imani haiwezekani kumpendeza Mungu… –Waebrania 11:6.” “Na wale walio wa Kristo wamekoma mwili pamoja na tamaa na matamanio yake –Wagalatia 5:24.”
findings.translation_quote: …neno lililohubiriwa halikuwa na faida kwao, lisikotanganywa na imani kwa wale waliolisikia –Waebrania 4:2.  Lakini bila imani haiwezekani kumpendeza yeye… –Waebrania 11:6.  …Wale wa Kristo wamekoma mwili pamoja na tamaa na tamaa zake –Wagalatia 5:24.
